summary.text: Steve Keyser is the Republican candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 15A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Steve Berch.
A retired police officer, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include property and grocery tax relief, a larger role for parents in education and medical decisions, and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Steve Keyser said in a Ballotpedia survey that his law enforcement career included patrol, detective work, supervision, narcotics, crime prevention and budgeting.
He said he volunteers with church benevolence projects, a local food pantry, a community medical clinic and programs that support grandparents raising their grandchildren.
He also noted that his son, Josh Keyser, represents neighboring Legislative District 20 in the Idaho State Senate.
Keyser was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2022, when Berch defeated him in the general election, and he advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
